The simulator is complete. The implementation in `/workspace/output/` consists of:

- **main.js** (417 lines) — CLI entry point, argument parsing, output writing
- **parser.js** (472 lines) — Lexer, expression evaluator with all RS274 operators
- **state.js** (200 lines) — `MachineState` class with modal groups, coord systems, parameters
- **interpreter.js** (~900 lines) — Block executor handling all G/M codes, motion, CRC, probing, G53/G92/G10/G28/G30
- **canned_cycles.js** (563 lines) — G81 through G89 expansion into sub-motions
- **trace.js** (626 lines) — Trace generation with all three stepping modes, delta computation, scalar/coord/param diffs
- **io.js** (112 lines) — Tool and parameter file reading/writing

Verified features:
- Linear/arc motion (G0/G1/G2/G3) with units (G20/G21), planes (G17/18/19), distance modes (G90/G91), feed modes (G93/G94)
- Canned cycles (G81-G89) with sticky values, L repeats, G98/G99 retract
- Coord systems (G54-G59.3, G10), G92 offsets, G53 machine motion, G28/G30 home
- Tool length (G43/G49), cutter compensation (G40/G41/G42) including D0
- Probe (G38.2) with `--probe-box` and `--probe-tool`
- M0-M9, M30, M48/49, M60, M6 tool change
- Parameter expressions, parallel parameter setting, `MSG,` comments
- Trace output with `--trace-time-step`, `--trace-distance-step`, `--trace-position-tolerance`
- Error handling with exit codes (1 spec error, 2 internal), error reporting in both output and trace files
- Parameter file I/O with required defaults per Table 2
